title: R4 西西弗斯标度律：T(4I) − 3T(2I) + 2T(I) = 0（lin⊥lin 稳态 T_z 对光强线性；不检验斜率与 T 本身）
derivation: k_BT = c·ħΩ²/|δ| + O(E_rec) at |δ| ≫ Γ and low saturation: at one detuning T is linear in the intensity, so T(4I) − 3T(2I) + 2T(I) = 0 for the steady states of three scenes that differ in the intensity alone. Tested: that the steady T_z rises with I and is an affine function of it, the second difference zero within z·√(SE² + u²) (no user's target: D is no temperature). Not tested: the slope c, the offset, T itself -- every T = a + bI with b > 0 passes, so does a deficit of T that keeps it affine in I.

conditions.what: δ from the cycle’s line in the trap / Γ
largest excited population in the lowest light-shift potential, at I, 2I, 4I
the lowest light-shift potential’s modulation over E_rec, at I, 2I, 4I
Ω_osc τ_p, at I, 2I, 4I: oscillations in the light’s wells between two pumpings
pumping times over the run, at I, 2I, 4I
photons scattered over the run, at I, 2I, 4I
(ω_z/Ω_osc)² at I: the tweezer against the oscillation in the light’s wells
κ = δ_LS(0)/U₀ (the line’s shift over the cloud is κk_BT)
u from the scenes (relative to T(4I))

requirements: classical: every output of the window is one the result calls classical, in every member
steady: T̄ over the window’s two halves equal within twice their standard errors, in every member
a rise: T̄(4I) − T̄(I) beyond twice its standard error (a fall beyond it fails)
